correctness.rationale: For a subset of vertices in K_m vee H, a forbidden K4 exists unless its clique-part size r<=1 (unrestricted H), r=2 (H-independent part), or r=3 (H-part empty), while r>=4 is impossible. Hence the actual simplicial complex is B∪Y with B=Delta_H*D_A contractible (H nonempty), Y=(Ind(H)*E_A)∪T_A and intersection Z=Ind(H)*D_A. Cofibration of finite subcomplexes gives X≃Y/Z by contracting B. Each edge block quotient (L*Delta_edge)/(L*partial Delta_edge) is the unreduced double suspension Sigma^2|L|; distinct blocks intersect only in Z. The resulting wedge is simply connected for every nonempty L, so every apex-only triangle boundary loop is null and contributes an independent S2. This proves the full homotopy splitting over Z, not just field homology. Triangle-free is sharp: H=K3,m=2 instead yields CF4(K5)≈wedge4 S2 while excluded formula would give wedge2 S2. Independent K3 vee C5 face and boundary computation yielded beta_2=1, beta_3=3 over F2, consistent with S2 vee 3S3; universal claim rests on cofiber argument.
